thread:
maria: Heads-up — kicking off a staggered escrow canary for rwd-v3-int4 now. Strategy: 3-step slow roll (1% -> 2% -> 10%) with a 5% escrow reserve at each step. Escrow traffic is *held* (not served to users) and used for automated and manual evals. posting the plan below — please review :eyes:

devin: SG. quick q: what exactly triggers auto-fallback? thresholds? metric windows?

maria: auto-fallback = enabled. triggers are evaluated per-step using the escrow sample + live served slice. quick summary: relative concordance drop > 0.8% OR hallucination_rate increase > 1.0 percentage point OR p95 latency > +20ms vs baseline => immediate fallback for that step. need at least 2k escrow samples OR 30m of step time, whichever comes first.

anjali: can you paste the config we pushed to the canary service? saves me looking it up.

maria: sure — config we applied to canary controller:```yaml
canary:
  steps: [1, 2, 10]
  escrow_pct: 5
  min_escrow_samples_per_step: 2000
  min_step_duration_minutes: 30
  metrics:
    - name: concordance@core
      mode: relative
      threshold: -0.008   # -0.8%
    - name: hallucination_rate@openqa
      mode: absolute
      threshold: 0.01    # +1.0pp
    - name: p95_latency_ms
      mode: absolute
      threshold: 20      # +20ms
  auto_fallback: true
  notify: ["maria", "devin", "eng-oncall"]
```

sam: minor nit — concordance uses smoothed windows, right? don't want a spiky 5-min blip to drop it.

maria: yep, we use an exponential smoothing with alpha=0.2 over the escrow window. also require monotonic confirmation: a single breach raises an alert and auto-fallback only if breached for 2 consecutive evaluation windows (~10min).

devin: any special handling for long-context QA slice? our int4 tends to trim answers there.

anjali: saw that on the shadow run yesterday. On the "longcontext" slice (avg tokens > 1500) we saw concordance down ~1.6% but shortform improved ~0.6%. Proposal: apply slice-level guardrail: escrow_pct=10 for longcontext and require +50% more escrow samples before promoting that slice.

maria: agree. I've added an override in the canary rule set for slice "longcontext": escrow_pct: 10, min_escrow_samples_per_step: 3000.

devin: good. what's the A/B baseline window we compare against? last stable model (rwd-v3) full-week?

maria: baseline is rwd-v3 (pinned). we compare rolling 24h for latency and 72h for quality signals where available. for slices with low traffic, we fallback to historical bootstrap (7d) to stabilize variance.

sam: FYI ran a quick A/B on summarization slice: n=5.4k samples across both arms in first 2h. rwd-v3-int4 (candidate) improved rouge-L by +0.9 but recall-based QA concordance dropped -0.7. Not auto-fallback level yet but worth monitoring.

anjali: will run the hallucination classifier on escrow samples every 10m and post a rolling trend to the canary dashboard. link: https://console.redwood/inference/canaries/1715554321 :point_left:

canary-bot: snapshot: step=1, served=1.0% (+5% escrow), escrow_samples=1200/2000, concordance_delta=-0.25%, halluc_rate_delta=+0.30pp, p95_latency=+6ms. next eval in 8m.

maria: thanks bot. action items: (1) @anjali increase escrow classifier cadence to 10m (2) @devin monitor longcontext slice; escalate if concordance delta crosses -1.0% sustained (3) I'll hold promotion until step 1 meets min samples or 30m.

devin: noted. I'll slack-eng-oncall if we see sustained dips.

anjali: increasing cadence now. also enabling a quiet-burn shadow for a 2k-sample audit on the "policy" slice where we historically see hallucination regressions.

maria: perfect. if all looks stable after step 2 we plan a slow 10% serving with escrow dropped to 2% then collect 24h before promo. will ping when we move to step 2. :rocket:

sam: 👍 keep logs of per-request kernel/quantization flags so we can correlate perf regressions (e.g., aten kernel fallback).

maria: added telemetry logs to the canary envelope. thanks all.

canary-bot: reminder: auto-fallback WILL trigger if configured thresholds are exceeded for 2 consecutive eval windows.

maria: end of thread — will post step transitions and final A/B summary once step 2 completes.
